answer: Route every reward claim through a glacier: a frozen contestable window with its evidence published. Any of a grove of independent challengers can post a fraud proof -- shell duplication, copied work, correlated timing -- and take part of the fraudulent claim as bounty. The claim's evidence sits in a cedar log no one can rewrite, so attackers cannot quietly prune their trail. A sybil farm adding shells only grows the surface that bounty hunters are paid to inspect, turning each attack into a subsidy for its own detection; honest agents make one claim and pass unchallenged.
